THE SAME LIST, ACROSS THE WHOLE FRAME
It is born as one span, the whole screen. Portals cut it into pieces, solid walls delete the pieces behind them, and abutting spans left with the same

top and bottom lines are merged back into one. Twelve wall closes and one object pass later nothing is open, so the traversal stops early: 293,937 cycles for this view, and the rest of the tree is never visited.
half-open [lo,hi) everywhere · two compares settle most spans · the trapezoid clip runs only when the line's y range meets the band a boundary sweeps across the span
